name: Marketing Bot
tagline: Turn a project description into X launch copy worth tapping
description: Answer a short set of questions about your project and it returns launch copy shaped for X. You get one standalone post, a short thread covering the same announcement, and replies written to earn a tap instead of filling space. Adjust the answers and regenerate until the framing sounds like something you would post.
author: BragiHelvig
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
